context: Two teens chat after a school festival
purpose: Teach: 正体/気力/叫ぶ/誘わ/親族/見つめる/うれしく/年上

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お化け屋敷で、隣の年上の先輩が思わず叫ぶの、面白かった。
lines.en: It was actually funny watching the older senpai next to me scream at the haunted house.
lines.style: Quick, animated delivery. Eyes bright with the memory of it. A slight smile underneath—amused, not mean. Pace picks up on the image of the scream, then settles.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 正体が分かったら、急に気力なくしてたな。
lines.en: Yeah, but the second they figured out how it worked, they just… deflated.
lines.style: Dry, knowing half-laugh. Lean-back tone. Not unkind—just observing the funny reality of the moment. Light vocal shrug on the trailing silence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちの親族、ひとり来てくれて、うれしくて。
lines.en: I was really happy one of my relatives came with us.
lines.style: Softer here. A small, genuine warmth surfaces. Not performing happiness—just stating something true that still makes her a little brighter. Slight breath-catch on 'really.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 明日も部活に誘われたんだ。
lines.en: They asked me to come to club activities tomorrow too.
lines.style: Lower register, almost to himself. Matter-of-fact on the surface, but a quiet current underneath—this matters more than the delivery lets on. Steady eye contact with the memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 写真の中で、笑顔見つめると、心が温かくなる。
lines.en: When I look at their smile in that photo, it just… warms me.
lines.style: Quieter, almost private. A slow inhale before speaking. Tender, unguarded. Pace slows—like she's actually looking at the photo as she speaks. Trailing off into the feeling itself.
